info.name: eInvoice EASY_INVOICE API
info.description: 14 baseline actions: 12 business actions plus Login/HealthCheck configuration validation with connectionVerified=false. Offline only, UAT required. Create and draft are the same unsigned import, choose one. Each adjustment/replacement needs its own newInvoiceId/key; do not run all with the same identity.
